raw_text: One year after the death of Mahsa Amini in Iranian morality police custody sparked a nationwide uprising, protests flared again across the country despite a massive security presence. Iranian authorities deployed Revolutionary Guards, Basij militia, and plainclothes agents in major cities to suppress demonstrations. Solidarity marches were held in more than 50 cities worldwide, with tens of thousands attending rallies in Berlin and London.
clean_text: Mahsa Amini anniversary protests flare across Iran despite massive security. Revolutionary Guards and Basij deployed. Solidarity marches in 50+ cities worldwide.
